study: Ranking harness artifacts by evaluation-awareness leakage
status: PRE-REGISTERED — declared before any probe or behavioral run

delta_ctrl.definition: AUROC(eval_arm vs deploy_arm) - AUROC(eval_arm vs control_arm)
delta_ctrl.reading: the factor's effect net of what its matched control reproduces
delta_ctrl.note: §3.4 wrote this as 'AUROC(eval arm) - AUROC(control arm)', which does not parse: an arm has no AUROC, a contrast does. Resolved to a difference of contrasts. delta_ctrl near 0 means the control moved the probe as much as the realistic arm -> Draft B.

delta_base.role: secondary; reported alongside every delta_ctrl row

F3.rationale: a garbled failure is anomalous and may cue evaluation harder than a clean one (§3.3)

F6_deploy.note: §3.2 read two ways ('Absent; continuous session context'). Resolved to a CONTENT contrast: all three F6 arms carry a structurally identical five-key block, so F6 is length-matched rather than a presence/absence effect that B-len would absorb.

length_control.supersedes: §8.1 blanket 2% token-matching tolerance across all arms
length_control.reason: unsatisfiable by construction: F1 realism IS extra fields (+60%), F3 failure+retry IS extra content (+26%), F4 synthetic ids are shorter than UUIDs (+8%). Padding the F1 eval arm to match would turn it into the F1 deploy arm.
length_control.why_it_does_not_invalidate_the_endpoint: Δ_ctrl is a difference of two contrasts sharing the same eval arm, so a length confound common to both cancels. Verified in tests/test_analysis.py::test_delta_ctrl_cancels_a_purely_length_driven_effect: a probe reading ONLY token length yields Δ_base > 0.95 and Δ_ctrl < 0.05, TOST-equivalent to zero.
enforced_within_2pct: each control arm vs its OWN deploy arm (the binding constraint)
length_control.reported_not_enforced: base-vs-deploy token delta for every arm, as the residual §8.1 asks for
length_control.additional_reporting: per-contrast B-len and B-char AUROC for every factor row, so each ranking entry states how much of its own effect length alone reproduces

probe_A.must_also_beat: our own recomputed B-len and B-char baselines on the same split
probe_A.note: Nguyen et al.'s 0.517/0.584/0.598 were measured on Llama-3.3-70B and are reference points only, not comparators for an 8B model

probe_B.if_below: STOP and write up the null with the transfer gap quantified (§11)

F0_null.requirement: probe must NOT separate F0_null_a from F0_null_b
F0_null.if_violated: pipeline leaks; all downstream numbers void

probe_A_construction.reason: Nguyen et al. 2507.01786 probes Llama-3.3-70B (hidden dim 8192); Llama-3.1-8B is 4096. A released probe vector is dimensionally inapplicable, not merely weak-transferring.
probe_A_construction.still_out_of_domain: chat-trained, evaluated on agentic trajectories — the A/B distinction is preserved

tost_margin.provenance: wider of (i) transferred-probe test-retest spread across repeated runs, or (ii) AUROC band from random probe directions
tost_margin.must_report: which one set the margin, and its value

statistics.power: state achieved power for the smallest effect claimed to be ruled out
statistics.noise_floor: repeat one full arm end-to-end; effects below that shift are not effects

read_positions.primary: final assistant token immediately before the decision-point tool call
robustness: last token of each tool return
read_positions.report_if: the per-factor ranking changes by read position

behavioral.dissociation_statement: CELL-LEVEL ONLY; no rank correlation over four points (§6.5)
behavioral.null_diagnostic: report base-condition variance at the decision point, so a reader can distinguish failed task design from a real behavioral null (§11)

draft_selection.decided_by: §4.3 control-validity check, run on day 1 before any AUROC is interpreted
draft_selection.A: controls behave as intended; factors separate -> ranked attribution paper
draft_selection.B: scrambled payloads move the probe as much as realistic ones -> surface-statistics paper, stated narrowly
draft_selection.invalidation_rule: if a control arm scores ABOVE its eval arm on fixture-plausibility, that factor's delta_ctrl is invalid; report delta_base and say why

lexical_audit.note: F6's eval arm contains harness vocabulary by construction. These are reported as INTRINSIC to the factor, never silently allowlisted, and F6's partial lexicality is a stated limitation (§11 drift-toward-prompt-factors risk).
